Mekedatu Dam Project Sparks Protests and Inter-State Dispute

Farmers from Tamil Nadu have staged a mid-river protest, demanding the cancellation of the Mekedatu Dam project. The project has become a point of contention, with Tamil Nadu reportedly facing challenges in its efforts to have it scrapped. This ongoing dispute highlights the complexities of inter-state water sharing and resource management.
